lines.speaker: THE JUDGE
lines.text: The court finds you guilty. You are sentenced to seven days in Blackwater. Your choices decide how this sentence ends.

lines.speaker: BLACKWATER PA
lines.text: Welcome to Blackwater. Your cell is A zero one. Keep your head up, follow the routine, and make every day count.

lines.speaker: BLACKWATER PA
lines.text: The cafeteria is now open. Collect your meal at the counter, then find a free seat. One meal per prisoner.

lines.speaker: OFFICER HALE
lines.text: Attention, prisoners. Curfew begins in thirty minutes. Finish what you are doing and return to your assigned cell.

lines.speaker: A CALL FROM HOME
lines.text: Hey, it's Dad. We miss you. Keep your head down and take care of yourself. We'll be waiting when those gates open.

lines.speaker: OFFICER HALE
lines.text: Your sentence is served. The gates are open. Walk out with your head held high, and make this a fresh start.

lines.speaker: BEYOND THE WALLS
lines.text: Fresh air. No bars. No footsteps behind you. Blackwater fades into the distance. The rest of the story is yours.

lines.speaker: BLACKWATER PA
lines.text: This is Blackwater public address. Voices and sound effects are powered by ElevenLabs. Seven days. Two ways out.
